'''Spaceport Eight''' was a a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The spaceport was less confusing to navigate than [[Spaceport Nine]], as unlike the latter it was not being reworked by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="SoS" />
